Table 1: Comparison of basic vs. advanced chart reasoning tasks. Basic tasks require localizing a single region and one-step retrieval. Advanced tasks require aggregating evidence across multiple regions and multi-step computation.

Figure 2: Case study comparing reasoning approaches. We illustrate how different methods handle an advanced chart reasoning question. CoT reasons sequentially over the global image but struggles with fine-grained details. Thinking w/ Images iteratively zooms into regions but accumulates all crops and intermediate reasoning in a growing context, leading to errors. HIERVA manages the context effectively by using hierarchical agents and scoped context. Red text highlights incorrect reasoning steps.
